texts.zh: 我们探测到有什么东西从希洛士恒星系中传出。那艘叫乌布梅的幽灵船使用一种只能说是“灵能频段”的东西在不断地发出悲伤的哭嚎。显然，自从我们第一次遇到这艘船和被困在船上的新生意识以来它就一直如此了。似乎我们最近的灵能飞升是我们能听到这个孩子哭泣的缘由。通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与之联系。
texts.en: We have detected something unusual emanating from the Hillos system. On what can only be described as a 'psionic frequency', the so-called ghost ship Ubume has been issuing a plaintive and irregular wail. Apparently, this has been going on since our first encounter with the vessel and the nascent consciousness trapped onboard. It seems likely that our recent psionic transcendence is the reason we're now able to perceive the child's cries. With further study, we may even be able to answer them.

texts.zh:
我们探测到有什么东西从希洛士恒星系中传出。我们最近调谐的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]已经开始接收来乌布梅舰船的信号。这些通信与生物意义上的年轻人有相似之处，并且显示出自我们最初相遇以来已经传播的迹象，我们最近的灵能发展使最终探测到它们成为可能。

通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与进行更多交流。
texts.en:
We have detected something unusual emanating from the Hillos system. Our recently attuned [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have begun to receive signals emanating from the vessel Ubume. These communications share similarities with those of biological young, and show signs of having been broadcast since our initial encounter, with our recent psionic developments making it possible to finally detect them.

With further study, we may be able to communicate with the entity further.

texts.zh: 在希洛士星系检测到的灵能低语很显然属于被困在“幽灵船”乌布梅上的人工意识体。
texts.en: The psionic chatter detected in the Hillos system appears to belong to the artificial consciousness trapped aboard the 'ghost ship' Ubume.

texts.zh: 在经过几个月痛苦的研究后，我们的灵能使终于成功地与占据幽灵船乌布梅的那个意识取得联系。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过希洛士星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，“闹鬼”的希洛士恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
texts.en: After months of painful research, our telepaths have succeeded in making contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship Ubume. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions. The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with other minds. It also seems to have taken a liking to our science vessel, playfully gliding throughout the Hillos system alongside the ship, much like the calf of a water-born cetacean around its mother. At last, the haunting of the Hillos system has come to a happy end.

texts.zh:
在数月的高强度研究之后，我们的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]终于能和这个占据着幽灵船乌布梅的意识沟通了。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。

这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。而且，它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过希洛士星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，诡异的希洛士恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
texts.en:
After months of extensive research, our [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have successfully made contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship Ubume. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions.

The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with other minds. Additionally, it seems to have taken a liking to our science vessel, playfully gliding throughout the Hillos system alongside the ship, much like the calf of a water-born cetacean around its mother. The anomalous behavior it caused in the Hillos system has ceased.
